subject: Post-demo: Evaluation sprint & POC commitments — MountainData
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@mountaindata.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@mountaindata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Evaluation sprint & POC commitments — MountainData

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Helpful conversation — appreciate the clarity on your ingestion and latency constraints. As promised, attaching a starter POC scope and an estimate for a 4-week evaluation sprint so your engineering and data teams can validate performance and integration effort. High-level summary below and a request for one quick decision point to keep momentum.

Summary (what Redwood will deliver during the 4-week POC)
- Environment: Hosted sandbox instance in us-west with private network peering (limited to test data).
- Model / runtime: Redwood-managed mpt-7b-q4f with KV caching enabled; estimate 40k tokens/day average.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  * End-to-end latency <= 350ms median for 512-token responses on 95% of requests.
  * Retrieval + generation correctness: F1 >= 0.82 on the 200-item validation set you shared.
  * Integration: Embedding pipeline (vector store) ingest and upsert with end-to-end sample query working from your staging app.
- Roles & ownership:
  * Redwood: Mateo (eng lead) — runtime/config, Ben (solutions) — onboarding, Irene (security) — network/KMS setup.
  * MountainData: Oliver (technical lead) — test dataset, Priya (product) — success criteria sign-off.
- Timeline:
  * Week 0 (kickoff): network peering, credentials, test data sample ingest (3 days).
  * Weeks 1–3: integrations, performance tuning, weekly checkpoints.
  * Week 4: acceptance run, final report + recommendations.

Decision we need from you to start: confirm the acceptance metric for retrieval/generation (we proposed F1 >= 0.82) and whether MountainData will allow a synthetic copy of a 200-item sample dataset (PII-sanitized) to be uploaded to the sandbox.

Attachments: mountaindata-poc-scope.xlsx (scope + timeline), redwood-poc-estimate.pdf (cost and term options).

Next steps I propose:
1) Priya confirms success metric and data permission by Tue 21 Jul EOD.
2) I schedule a 30-minute kickoff with your infra and Eng (Oliver + ingestion owner).

Thanks — I can be flexible on kickoff timing next week (Mon/Tue mornings PT ideal).

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai

---
From: Oliver Chen <oliver@mountaindata.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <psingh@mountaindata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Evaluation sprint & POC commitments — MountainData

Thanks Mateo — good recap. Couple quick items from our side: 

- The F1 >= 0.82 threshold is reasonable as a target; we'll aim to validate against that.
- We can provide a sanitized 200-item sample. I'll coordinate with our data steward; likely delivery Wed morning PT.
- Two asks: can you confirm what level of logging/audit we’ll get in the sandbox (token-level cost breakdown + request trace)? Also, do you support customer-managed keys for the test instance?

If those are OK, we can do a kickoff Thurs 22 Jul at 10:00 AM PT. Priya — can you confirm if that time works?

-Oliver

Hi Oliver — great, thanks for the quick reply. Short answers to your asks: 

- Logging/audit: yes — we’ll provide per-request traces and token-level cost breakdown in the Console for the sandbox with 30-day retention. We’ll include example dashboards in the kickoff packet.
- Customer-managed keys: yes for the private sandbox — Irene will coordinate the KMS/HSM flow; for the hosted sandbox we offer bring-your-own-key via KMS integration (we’ll need an IAM role and a key ARN).

Thursday 22 Jul 10:00 AM PT works for us; I’ll send a calendar invite to lock it. Agenda I propose (30min):
- 5m intros & goals
- 10m infra/network checklist & data handoff (Oliver + your ingestion owner)
- 10m POC acceptance criteria & checkpoints (Priya + Mateo)
- 5m next steps and risks

I attached a slightly updated scope sheet with a short acceptance checklist (mountaindata-poc-scope.xlsx). Two small clarifications I added: 1) we’ll run load tests at 1x and 3x expected traffic to validate SLO headroom, and 2) if the F1 target is narrowly missed, we’ll propose model variant + quantization changes rather than immediately extending the POC.

Ben — looping you for onboarding cadence and to confirm we have a staging project reserved next week.

Thanks — will send invite in the next 10m.

Best,
Mateo
